category_basis: All works are ukiyo-e woodblock prints first published c. 1830-1832, well before the 1929 US fixed-term cutoff, and the artist died in 1849 (life+70 expired 1919). Every file is tagged on Wikimedia Commons with an explicit PD rationale (PD-old-100-expired / PD-Art) or is Met Museum Open Access CC0.
